title: Marinobacter shengliensis subsp. alexandrii Subsp. Nov., Isolated from Cultivable Phycosphere Microbiota of Highly Toxic Dinoflagellate Alexandrium catenella LZT09 and Description of Marinobacter shengliensis Subsp. shengliensis Subsp. Nov.
abstract: Phycosphere hosts the boundary of unique holobionts harboring dynamic algae-bacteria interactions.
